customers_say: Customers find the smart lock functions well and offers excellent value for money, with one noting it works seamlessly with digital assistants. The installation process is straightforward, and they appreciate its security features, with one highlighting its secure multi-bolt system. The appearance receives positive feedback for its premium finish and wow factor, while the build quality feels strong, and customers like its versatile access options. Battery life experiences are mixed, with some reporting good performance while others mention the battery depleting within a year.
